detail.longDescription: Responsibility and accountability are the two things you can't automate in enterprise AI. My new post is about bringing AI into business execution so it's safe, secure, confidently capable and cost efficient. It covers blast radius controls and where humans sit in, on and out of the loop, plus making agents earn autonomy and treating token spend as an architecture decision. https:// ryanthomashuff.com/enterprise- ai-guardrails/ # AI # AgenticAI # AIGovernance # NetworkEngineering # OTSecurity
